info.title: FeatureSlash API
info.description: The FeatureSlash server's admin API and SDK read API. Every route under /api/v1 takes `Authorization: Bearer <admin token>`, or a scoped token where its project and permission allow it. GET /sdk/v1/ruleset and GET /sdk/v1/stream take a server SDK key; POST /sdk/v1/evaluate takes a server or a client SDK key.
